subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Gateway/provider-backed editable dictation path in the Control UI composer, or keep this voice-input work inside the broader WebChat voice direction for now?
rationale: The request adds new browser microphone capture and an operator-write transcription boundary that affects provider routing, credentials, temporary audio handling, and user-facing Talk semantics.

options.title: Proceed through linked PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 and land it only after proof, accessibility, authorization, and cleanup concerns are acceptable.

options.title: Fold into broader voice tracker
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 as canonical and retarget or close the narrow dictation PR until the full STT/TTS split is settled.

options.title: Keep Talk/media only
options.body: Reject composer dictation for now and keep Control UI voice input limited to Talk sessions and audio attachments.

recommendation.title: Proceed through linked PR
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 and land it only after proof, accessibility, authorization, and cleanup concerns are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior server-side dictation slice and is the clearest history-backed owner for the Gateway-backed dictation direction.
